name: Imminent Stockout at Fulfillment Center
description: Stockout risk at Delhi NCR Fulfillment Center (SITE-DEL-04) for SKU-1042 (0.5 days cover). Air reroute is fast but exorbitantly priced, sea is too slow, local alternate supplier SUP-004 is cheapest viable.
report_text: CRITICAL INCIDENT: Stockout at Delhi NCR Fulfillment Center (SITE-DEL-04) for SKU-1042. Current inventory is critically depleted (50 units). Incoming shipment delayed by 8 days. Need 400 units urgently. Severity: 5.
test_purpose: Cost Agent drives choice: faster-but-pricier air expedite is rejected in favor of the cheapest viable supplier delivery.
